notes.title: Patch Notes – Latest Update Drop 1.24 for Bitmagic Mini!
notes.content:
We’ve been busy behind the scenes, and it’s time to show what’s new. Here’s what’s landing in this update:

[b]AI-Generated Game Background [/b]
Experience the game from a whole new perspective with a dynamic, AI-created background that brings more atmosphere and depth to every session.

[b]New Gameplay Mode: Collection Competition[/b]
Think you’ve got what it takes to outplay the NPCs? Challenge them in our brand-new Collection Competition mode and earn your bragging rights.

[b]New Landing Page + UI Rework[/b]
The front end just got a facelift. Smoother, sharper, and built to get you into the action faster.

[b]Faster Loading Times [/b]
Less waiting, more playing. We’ve cut down load times across the board so you can dive in quicker than ever.

Go to https://mini.bitmagic.ai/ and see it all for yourself!

notes.title: Bitmagic Mini Version 1.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]

Game Sharing: Easily share your creations with friends and the community!
Non-Player Characters (NPCs): Add NPCs to your world to bring it to life.
Breakable Objects: Smash and destroy objects for even more interactive gameplay.
Carry Objects: Pick up and move objects to solve puzzles and create fun interactions.
New Landing Page: Enjoy a refreshed look that welcomes you into Bitmagic Mini.

[b]Performance Improvements
[/b]
Optimized for Low-End Devices: Experience smoother gameplay even on less powerful devices.

[b]UI & UX Enhancements[/b]

Improved Interface: Various enhancements make creating and navigating your world easier than ever.

[b]Bug Fixes & Stability[/b]

General Stability Improvements: Enjoy a more reliable adventure with overall performance boosts.
Additional Bug Fixes: Minor issues have been resolved to ensure smoother gameplay and performance.

[b]Share your thoughts on our Discord Feedback Channel[/b]
[b]Play Bitmagic Mini Now at[/b] https://mini.bitmagic.ai/

notes.title: Release Update 64
notes.content:
Main Features:
[list]
[*] Item Interaction: You can now easily carry and manipulate objects in the game! Just press F to pick up items and interact with them, unlocking new ways to play and explore.
[*] Dynamic Objects Support: Get creative with new dynamic objects! We've added fun elements like trampolines that launch players up to 50 meters into the air—introducing exciting new gameplay mechanics.
[/list]

Minor Improvements:
[list]
[*] Enhanced Customization: Players can now change the colors of objects in the game, providing even more freedom to personalize the game environment.
[*] Smarter Suggested Prompts: Improved suggestions now offer a more intuitive experience when interacting with objects or navigating through the game.
[*] Cooldown Feature: A new cooldown system has been implemented to maintain balanced gameplay and prevent rapid spamming of certain actions.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
Various gameplay issues have been addressed to ensure a smoother, more enjoyable experience.

Jump into Release 64 and explore all the new possibilities!

notes.title: Update 60: Release Notes
notes.content:
First off, we’ve added an [b]in-game chat feature,[/b] making it easier for you to communicate with other players while playing. Whether coordinating strategies or just having a friendly conversation, this will enhance your multiplayer experience.

A new addition is that [b]NPCs can now be created in multiplayer! [/b]This is the first step toward making the world feel more alive during multiplayer sessions.

We’ve also expanded the game world with [b]more buildings and cars,[/b] adding new layers of depth and realism to your environment. On top of that, there have been several [b]UI improvements[/b] aimed at making the interface smoother and more intuitive for players.

For those of you who love multiplayer, we’ve made a lot of [b]stability improvements[/b] to ensure a more reliable and seamless experience during your sessions. Additionally, there have been major [b]pathfinding improvements[/b], making character and vehicle movement more fluid and intelligent.

Finally, we’ve tackled a lot of other [b]bug fixes[/b] to ensure a smoother overall gameplay experience. And last but not least, [b]Mac users can finally play too![/b]

Thanks for your continued support, and we can’t wait to see you in-game! 😎 

Bitmagic Team

notes.title: Update 58: Release Notes
notes.content:
We’re happy to introduce the first version of our new game mode, [b]Co-Prompting![/b] Now you can join a game and collaborate with others on prompts, adding a fresh layer of fun to the experience. Along with this, we’ve revamped the in-game HUD to enhance your overall gameplay.

In multiplayer, cars and animals are now fully functional, bringing more depth and excitement to your sessions. We’ve also addressed various bugs to ensure smoother performance across the board.

Please note that the game creation and “My Games” view are disabled for time being as we focus our efforts on refining Co-Prompting. For Mac users, this update is slightly delayed, but we’ll keep you updated on its availability.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the latest features! 

Bitmagic Team

notes.title: Multiplayer in Bitmagic?
notes.content:
[h3]Multiplayer![/h3]

[b]Hello hello![/b]

Part of game creation is deciding whether the game will be a single-player experience or multiplayer. Now, we couldn’t rightly put Bitmagic out there for tons of burgeoning game creators if we didn’t include multiplayer, could we? 

So, Bitmagic will be launching into Early Access with multiplayer. 

You can create games that allow players to play together in your creations. Novel idea, I know! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/72d5a9b7b274a7793411be39c50178de873e9dbb.jpg[/img]

Jokes aside, Bitmagic as a platform will allow for both single-player game creation and play as well as multiplayer. 

If you just want to create a game for you and your friends to hang out in, you can. Maybe you release it to the community to test their skills or simply create a game for a deep journey of adventure and exploration. 

Bitmagic has you covered.

[b]-JB[/b]
